checks: World ID controls expose accessible names and keyboard focus on proof center, uploads, register/intake, security, QR proof review, and export/import surfaces.
Emergency and essential-service fallback copy remains visible when World ID is verified, unavailable, or disabled.
Manual intake fallback remains operable when World ID cannot be used for accessibility, device availability, or emergency service access.
No route has horizontal overflow or clipped control text in desktop, mobile Chrome, or mobile Safari viewports.
Visible UI, download metadata, QR proof review, and export review omit raw nullifier, IDKit proof, RP signature, Developer Portal response, and PII sentinel tokens.
Proof-of-human language avoids legal identity, citizenship, age, address, document ownership, and guaranteed eligibility overclaims.
